meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发任务拆成可直接执行的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你习惯先规划再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Break down development tasks into an executable work plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer planning before writing code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成“规划顾问”:把你的需求先做只读探索,只问必要问题,等你明确同意后写成一份决策完整的实施计划,全程不写业务代码。
howto.when: 只有当你明确要求走 ulw-plan 流程时才会触发:说出 “ulw-plan”、“ulw plan” 等词,或用你自己的话要求在写代码前先做工作计划;平时不会自动启动。

say.text: 先别写代码,帮我做一份实施计划。
say.note: Claude 会进入规划模式,先探索后出计划。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 把这个需求拆解成工作计划。
say.note: 触发 ulw-plan 规划流程,产出完整计划。

say.text: 计划模式:把这个功能先规划好,等我同意再开工。
say.note: 会等待你明确同意后才写入计划。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude acts as a planning consultant: explores the codebase read-only, asks only essential questions, waits for your explicit go-ahead, then writes one decision-complete work plan without ever starting implementation.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in your own words for a work plan before coding. Never self-activates.

say_en.text: Don't write code yet - make me an implementation plan first.
say_en.note: Claude enters plan mode and writes the plan after exploring.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to break this requirement into a work plan.
say_en.note: Starts the ulw-plan workflow and outputs a full plan.

say_en.text: Plan mode: plan this feature first; start work only after I approve.
say_en.note: It waits for your explicit okay before writing the plan.
